desc: **Task 0 (ideation):** Reformulate as non-increasing row-length sequence `a`, derive per-row bounds `L_x`/`U_x`, and establish the suffix-max feasibility criterion.
**Task 1 (implementation):** Fast I/O + per-row aggregation of `L[x]` (max y over B) and `U[x]` (min y−1 over W), then descending-row scan with running max; print Yes/No.
**Task 2 (edge cases):** N=1; all-B or all-W inputs; multiple cells per row; same-row conflicts; no O(N) allocations.
**Task 3 (validation):** All four samples verified (Yes, No, Yes, No), consistent with the dominance criterion "∃ black (x1,y1), white (x2,y2) with x2 ≤ x1 and y2 ≤ y1 ⇒ No".
